title: Private GitHub repository build initiation and status UI
intended_behavior: Signed browser request uses an opaque credential reference and approved public Vite settings.
Queued state is persisted only after fleet Gitea/HiveCI initiator acceptance.
The accepted outbound CI-bus event is durable Hive-CI kind 5401, parses through Bahia's trusted subscriber, and keeps its event id as ci_run_id for 5402 lineage.
UI renders projected statuses, evidence, and digest-pinned OCI candidates.
Missing mirror initiation fails closed without a direct GitHub runner.
